schema.text: Which of the following physical barriers do you face on your walking route? (Select all that apply)
schema.help: A dropped kerb is a section of the kerb lowered to the level of the road at a crossing.

options.text: Steps or steep curbs without ramps
Missing or broken dropped kerbs at crossings
Paths too narrow for a wheelchair, stroller, or two people to pass
Uneven paving, holes, or soft ground (grass or gravel)
Parked cars, trash bins, or construction signs blocking the path
Overhanging branches or bushes narrowing the usable space
Missing or broken tactile paving (for visually impaired users)
Stairs or flights of steps as the only way through, or stairways that are closed
No sidewalk at all, so I have to walk in the road
Pedestrian traffic lights that are out of order
I don't face any physical barrier

it.#Which of the following physical barrier: Quali dei seguenti ostacoli fisici incontri lungo il tuo percorso a piedi? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)
it.#A dropped kerb is a section of the kerb: Lo scivolo del marciapiede è un tratto del bordo abbassato al livello della strada in corrispondenza di un attraversamento.
it.#Steps or steep curbs without ramps: Gradini o marciapiedi con bordi alti senza rampe
it.#Missing or broken dropped kerbs at cros: Scivoli del marciapiede mancanti o danneggiati agli attraversamenti
it.#Paths too narrow for a wheelchair, stro: Percorsi troppo stretti per il passaggio di una sedia a rotelle, un passeggino o due persone
it.#Uneven paving, holes, or soft ground (g: Pavimentazione irregolare, buche o terreno morbido (erba o ghiaia)
it.#Parked cars, trash bins, or constructio: Auto parcheggiate, cassonetti o segnali di cantiere che bloccano il percorso
it.#Overhanging branches or bushes narrowin: Rami sporgenti o cespugli che restringono lo spazio utilizzabile
it.#Missing or broken tactile paving (for v: Pavimentazione tattile mancante o danneggiata (per utenti con disabilità visive)
it.#Stairs or flights of steps as the only: Scale o scalinate come unico passaggio, oppure scalinate chiuse
it.#No sidewalk at all, so I have to walk i: Marciapiede assente: devo camminare sulla strada

fr.#Which of the following physical barrier: Quels obstacles physiques rencontrez-vous sur vos trajets à pied ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#A dropped kerb is a section of the kerb: Une bordure abaissée est une partie de la bordure du trottoir mise au niveau de la chaussée à une traversée.
fr.#Steps or steep curbs without ramps: Marches ou bordures hautes sans rampe
fr.#Missing or broken dropped kerbs at cros: Bordures abaissées absentes ou endommagées aux traversées
fr.#Paths too narrow for a wheelchair, stro: Chemins trop étroits pour un fauteuil roulant, une poussette ou le passage de deux personnes
fr.#Uneven paving, holes, or soft ground (g: Sol irrégulier, trous ou terrain meuble (herbe ou gravier)
fr.#Parked cars, trash bins, or constructio: Voitures garées, poubelles ou panneaux de chantier qui bloquent le passage
fr.#Overhanging branches or bushes narrowin: Branches ou buissons qui réduisent l’espace disponible
fr.#Missing or broken tactile paving (for v: Bandes tactiles absentes ou endommagées pour les personnes malvoyantes
fr.#I don't face any physical barrier: Je ne rencontre aucun obstacle physique
fr.#Stairs or flights of steps as the only: Des escaliers comme seul passage possible, ou des escaliers fermés
fr.#No sidewalk at all, so I have to walk i: Pas de trottoir du tout : je dois marcher sur la chaussée
fr.#Pedestrian traffic lights that are out: Des feux pour piétons en panne

de.#Which of the following physical barrier: Welche körperlichen oder baulichen Hindernisse begegnen Ihnen auf Ihren Wegen zu Fuß? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)
de.#A dropped kerb is a section of the kerb: Ein abgesenkter Bordstein ist ein Teil der Bordsteinkante, der an einer Querung auf Fahrbahnhöhe abgesenkt ist.
de.#Steps or steep curbs without ramps: Stufen oder hohe Bordsteine ohne Rampe
de.#Missing or broken dropped kerbs at cros: Fehlende oder beschädigte abgesenkte Bordsteine an Querungen
de.#Paths too narrow for a wheelchair, stro: Wege, die zu schmal für Rollstuhl, Kinderwagen oder zwei Personen nebeneinander sind
de.#Uneven paving, holes, or soft ground (g: Unebener Belag, Löcher oder weicher Untergrund (Gras oder Kies)
de.#Parked cars, trash bins, or constructio: Geparkte Autos, Mülltonnen oder Baustellenschilder, die den Weg blockieren
de.#Overhanging branches or bushes narrowin: Überhängende Äste oder Büsche, die den nutzbaren Raum einschränken
de.#Missing or broken tactile paving (for v: Fehlende oder beschädigte taktile Bodenmarkierungen für sehbehinderte Menschen
de.#I don't face any physical barrier: Ich habe keine solchen körperlichen Hindernisse
de.#Stairs or flights of steps as the only: Treppen als einziger Durchgang oder gesperrte Treppen
de.#No sidewalk at all, so I have to walk i: Gar kein Gehweg, sodass ich auf der Fahrbahn gehen muss

tr.#Which of the following physical barrier: Yürüdüğünüz güzergâhlarda aşağıdaki fiziksel engellerden hangileriyle karşılaşıyorsunuz? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#A dropped kerb is a section of the kerb: Alçaltılmış kaldırım kenarı, bir geçiş noktasında yol seviyesine indirilmiş kaldırım bölümüdür.
tr.#Steps or steep curbs without ramps: Rampa olmayan basamaklar veya yüksek kaldırımlar
tr.#Missing or broken dropped kerbs at cros: Geçişlerde eksik veya bozuk alçaltılmış kaldırım kenarları
tr.#Paths too narrow for a wheelchair, stro: Tekerlekli sandalye, bebek arabası veya iki kişinin yan yana geçmesi için çok dar yollar
tr.#Uneven paving, holes, or soft ground (g: Düzensiz zemin, çukurlar veya yumuşak yüzeyler (çim veya çakıl)
tr.#Parked cars, trash bins, or constructio: Yolu kapatan park etmiş araçlar, çöp kutuları veya inşaat tabelaları
tr.#Overhanging branches or bushes narrowin: Kullanılabilir alanı daraltan sarkan dallar veya çalılar
tr.#Missing or broken tactile paving (for v: Görme engelli kişiler için eksik veya bozuk hissedilebilir yüzeyler
tr.#Stairs or flights of steps as the only: Tek geçiş yolu olarak merdivenler veya kapalı merdivenler
tr.#No sidewalk at all, so I have to walk i: Hiç kaldırım yok, bu yüzden yolda yürümek zorunda kalıyorum

fa.#Which of the following physical barrier: در مسیرهای پیاده‌روی با کدام موانع فیزیکی روبه‌رو می‌شوید؟ (همه گزینه‌های مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#A dropped kerb is a section of the kerb: جدول کوتاه‌شده بخشی از لبهٔ پیاده‌رو است که در محل عبور هم‌سطح خیابان پایین آورده شده است.
fa.#Steps or steep curbs without ramps: پله یا جدول بلند بدون رمپ
fa.#Missing or broken dropped kerbs at cros: نبود یا خرابی جدول کوتاه‌شده در محل عبور
fa.#Paths too narrow for a wheelchair, stro: مسیرهایی که برای ویلچر، کالسکه یا عبور دو نفر در کنار هم خیلی باریک‌اند
fa.#Uneven paving, holes, or soft ground (g: کف ناهموار، چاله یا سطح نرم (چمن یا شن)
fa.#Parked cars, trash bins, or constructio: خودروهای پارک‌شده، سطل زباله یا تابلوهای کارگاهی که مسیر را می‌بندند
fa.#Overhanging branches or bushes narrowin: شاخه یا بوته‌ای که فضای قابل استفاده را کم می‌کند
fa.#Missing or broken tactile paving (for v: نبود یا خرابی کفپوش برجسته برای افراد کم‌بینا
fa.#I don't face any physical barrier: با هیچ مانع فیزیکی روبه‌رو نمی‌شوم
fa.#Stairs or flights of steps as the only: پله یا راه‌پله به‌عنوان تنها راه عبور، یا راه‌پله‌های بسته
fa.#No sidewalk at all, so I have to walk i: پیاده‌رو اصلاً وجود ندارد و باید در سواره‌رو راه بروم
fa.#Pedestrian traffic lights that are out: چراغ‌های راهنمایی عابر پیاده که خراب هستند

hu.#Which of the following physical barrier: Milyen fizikai akadályokkal találkozik gyalogos útvonalán? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)
hu.#A dropped kerb is a section of the kerb: A lesüllyesztett járdaszegély a járdaszegélynek az a része, amelyet egy átkelőnél az úttest szintjére süllyesztettek.
hu.#Steps or steep curbs without ramps: Lépcsők vagy magas szegélyek rámpa nélkül
hu.#Missing or broken dropped kerbs at cros: Hiányzó vagy sérült lesüllyesztett járdaszegélyek az átkelőknél
hu.#Paths too narrow for a wheelchair, stro: Túl keskeny utak kerekesszékhez, babakocsihoz vagy két ember egymás melletti elhaladásához
hu.#Uneven paving, holes, or soft ground (g: Egyenetlen burkolat, lyukak vagy puha talaj (fű vagy kavics)
hu.#Parked cars, trash bins, or constructio: Az utat elzáró parkoló autók, kukák vagy építési táblák
hu.#Overhanging branches or bushes narrowin: Belógó ágak vagy bokrok, amelyek szűkítik a használható teret
hu.#Missing or broken tactile paving (for v: Hiányzó vagy sérült taktilis burkolat látássérült emberek számára
hu.#Stairs or flights of steps as the only: Lépcső mint egyetlen átjárási lehetőség, vagy lezárt lépcsők
hu.#No sidewalk at all, so I have to walk i: Egyáltalán nincs járda, ezért az úttesten kell mennem

ar.#Which of the following physical barrier: ما العوائق المادية التي تواجهها على طريقك أثناء المشي؟ (اختر كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#A dropped kerb is a section of the kerb: الحافة المنخفضة جزء من حافة الرصيف خُفِّض إلى مستوى الطريق عند المعبر.
ar.#Steps or steep curbs without ramps: درجات أو حواف مرتفعة من دون منحدر
ar.#Missing or broken dropped kerbs at cros: غياب أو تلف الحواف المنخفضة عند المعابر
ar.#Paths too narrow for a wheelchair, stro: مسارات ضيقة جدًا لكرسي متحرك أو عربة أطفال أو مرور شخصين بجانب بعضهما
ar.#Uneven paving, holes, or soft ground (g: أرض غير مستوية أو حفر أو أرض رخوة (عشب أو حصى)
ar.#Parked cars, trash bins, or constructio: سيارات متوقفة أو حاويات نفايات أو لافتات أعمال تسد الطريق
ar.#Overhanging branches or bushes narrowin: أغصان أو شجيرات متدلية تقلل المساحة المتاحة
ar.#Missing or broken tactile paving (for v: غياب أو تلف الأرضيات البارزة المخصصة لضعاف البصر
ar.#Stairs or flights of steps as the only: سلالم أو درجات هي الممر الوحيد، أو سلالم مغلقة
ar.#No sidewalk at all, so I have to walk i: لا يوجد رصيف إطلاقًا، لذلك عليّ المشي في الشارع
